commander-setup  Name this machine a commander and write the files it needs
  vars  name=laptop  dir=/home/alex/.config/caramelo  CacheDir=/home/alex/.cache  OS=linux

  parallel  the config, vpn and cache directories, private to the user
    config-dir   check  test -d "/home/alex/.config/caramelo" && test "$(stat -c %a ... )" = 700
                 exit 0  2ms
    config-dir     ok
    vpn-dir      check  test -d "/home/alex/.config/caramelo/vpn"
                 exit 0  1ms
    vpn-dir        ok
    cache-dir    check  test -d "/home/alex/.cache/caramelo"
                 exit 1  1ms
    cache-dir    cmd    install -d -m 0700 "/home/alex/.cache/caramelo"
                 exit 1  6ms
                 stderr:
                 install: cannot create directory '/home/alex/.cache/caramelo': Permission denied
                 install: (parent /home/alex/.cache is owned by root, mode 0755)
    cache-dir      failed    cmd exit 1
  config           not run
  identity         not run

commander-setup  ok=2  changed=0  skipped=0  failed=1   0.05s
report  /home/alex/.cache/caramelo/runs/20260918T203311.412Z.json
